title.zh: 《GENIUS法案》实施最终规则预计于10月底前出台
title.en: 《GENIUS法案》实施最终规则预计于10月底前出台

current_state.zh: US OCC Comptroller Jonathan Gould said the agency's final rules implementing the GENIUS Act are expected to be released before the end of October, speaking at a Milken Institute event during DC Fintech Week.
